preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 1 <= n <= 10**12 for n in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case n is an integer between 1 and 10^12 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all((int(line) == -1) or (int(line) >= 1) for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is either -1 or a positive integer.

postconditions.expression: all((int(stdout_lines[i]) == -1 and not exists_representation(test_cases[i], powerful_set)) or (int(stdout_lines[i]) == min_k(test_cases[i], powerful_set)) for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: For each test case, if no representation exists, output is -1; otherwise, output is the minimum number of distinct powerful numbers summing to n.
